title: Audit Workbench: session-replay and decision-inspector for access reviews
creator: Clara Nguyen
description: Design a lightweight Audit Workbench within the Redwood Console that helps admins investigate permission changes and access decisions by combining a compact session-replay of admin actions, a decision-inspector that surfaces policy triggers, and an integrated access-review composer. The workbench should: 1) let reviewers jump to a replay of the exact UI flow or API call that granted/revoked access, 2) show a timeline of related events and correlated logs (role assignments, SSO events, service account keys), 3) surface the policy decisions and attributes (role, workspace, scope, ttl, justification) that caused the change, and 4) provide quick actions to open a targeted access review, revert a change, or annotate the audit record. Deliverables: high-fidelity Figma prototype of the workbench panel, interaction specs for replay scrubber and filters, annotated handoff for engineering, and a 6-user moderated usability script.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype shows session-replay scrubber with timestamped events
Decision inspector lists policy triggers and correlated metadata
Quick actions exist for open-access-review, revert-change, add-annotation
Edge-case: multiple related role changes are grouped into a single expandable incident
Handoff contains component specs, accessible color tokens, and example API payloads
comments: 2025-11-05 - Clara Nguyen: Kickoff completed with PM and Eng. Agreement to scope MVP to workspace-level audits first, org-level to follow in a later iteration.
2025-11-08 - Aisha Patel: Early wireframes uploaded to Figma. Chose a right-hand workbench panel pattern to avoid disrupting current audit list flows. UI will support both compact and expanded modes.

2025-11-10 - Marcus Li (Eng): Flagged performance constraint: session-replay will need event sampling and server-side precomputation for long timelines. We agreed on a 30-day full-history slice for MVP and summarized histograms beyond that.
2025-11-12 - Priya Shah (PM): Requested clear privacy affordances and masking for PII in replay. Added requirement to use KMS-backed redaction keys for stored snapshots.

2025-11-14 - Aisha Patel: Usability study script drafted. Plan to run 6 moderated sessions with platform admins in Cycle 46. Key tasks: find root cause of a user losing access, create an access-review for an offboarded teammate, and revert a mistaken role grant.

2025-11-17 - Clara Nguyen: Design critique notes from Design Lead: tighten microcopy around revert/rollback to avoid accidental use, add inline confirmation with reason required, and highlight degraded states when replay is partial.

2025-11-19 - Eng Review (Marcus Li): Provided API contract suggestions and prefetched endpoints. Suggested adding a "replay-ready" flag in the audit record and a lightweight event-aggregation API to power the scrubber.
2025-11-20 - Aisha Patel: Updated prototype to include decision-inspector panel with rule trace, and added keyboard shortcuts for scrubber. Preparing final handoff doc for next week.
